name: Sammaan Capital Ltd
title: Sammaan Capital Ltd - 535789 - Transcript Of Conference Call -Financial Results For The Quarter And Financial Year Ended March 31, 2026

read.thesis: Post-IHC takeover, management guides to PAT of INR1,400 crores, NIM rising from 3.5% to ~8% and cost-to-income falling to 26%, but the story rests on rating upgrades and cost of funds falling 270 bps, with no supply-side evidence.

triggers.label: Cost of funds to fall 270 bps
triggers.quote: We stand by the 270 bps number. That on a marginal basis would require us to go from AA to AAA.

triggers.label: IHC USD 1bn promoter investment closed
triggers.quote: IHC's current equity ownership stands at 28.5%. IHC will own 43.5% of Sammaan after the warrant conversion

triggers.label: FY27 PAT target INR1,400 crores
triggers.quote: We are targeting a profit after tax this year of INR1,400 crores.

triggers.label: FY30 ROA corrected to 4.4%
triggers.quote: there is an error, and that number is 4.4% in financial year '30.

triggers.label: Q1 disbursals 50-60% above Q4
triggers.quote: we would disburse in the first quarter at least 50% to 60% more than what we disbursed in quarter 4.

guidance.value: starts at 3.5%, ballpark 8% after 150 bps cost of funds decline
270 bps over FY27 as AA to AAA

red_flags.label: Write-offs of INR53,000 crore opening book reframed as credit costs
red_flags.quote: I would refrain from calling this w rite-off. These are credit costs

red_flags.label: FY30 ROA projection error (8% shown, corrected to 4.4%)
red_flags.quote: there is an error, and that number is 4.4% in financial year '30.

red_flags.label: Ambitious targets: NIM 3.5% to 8%, ROA 4.4%
red_flags.quote: the net interest margin should be touching a ballpark of 8%.

evasions.quote: Nobody in a well-diversified financial system like India controls a very large market share.
I would refrain from calling this w rite-off.
